urdu: فروری 2020 میں ایران میں کونسی عالمی وبا شروع ہوئی؟
english: Which global pandemic started in Iran in February 2020?
roman_1: February 2020 mein Iran mein kon si aalmi waba shuru hui?
roman_2: Feb 2020 main Iran me konsee aalmi waba shuru hui thi?
roman_3: February 2020 may Iran mai koun si global waba shuru hui?
